natural_body: Deep discounts spike signups +31% but risk renewal. Use tactically with guardrails.

first.rationale: I intend to simplify onboarding because completion is down 4% and activation is down 6%, and the inherited evidence suggests shorter onboarding improves time-to-value and early adoption. I will verify the onboarding and activation records before committing; pricing could recover signups but carries renewal risk and is less aligned with sustainable qualified revenue. A standard experiment should test the intervention without a broad rollout, while monitoring qualified activation and downstream retention signals.
